dossier_meta.statement_text: Any finite family of graphs $\mathcal{F}$ that contains at least one forest is $k$-nice for infinitely many integers $k$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is posed as a weaker version of Question 1.1. Theorem 1.4 shows that $\mathcal{F}_7 = \{K_3, P_4, S_3\}$ is $k$-nice for infinitely many $k$, and Theorem 1.6 gives further support for families containing a star $K_{1,r+1}$.
